name: Discouraged
overview: Scripture addresses the reality of being discouraged by encouraging believers to find strength and courage in God's presence and promises. God commands His people to be strong and not dismayed because He is always with them, offering help, strength, and righteousness (Joshua 1:9; Isaiah 41:10). Believers are called to turn to God as a stronghold and prisoner of hope, trusting in His faithfulness to reward perseverance (Zechariah 9:12; Galatians 6:9). Through prayer and thanksgiving, Christians can experience joy and peace that overflow in hope by the power of the Holy Spirit, guarding against anxiety and weariness (Philippians 4:6; Romans 15:13).
